design_decisions: Frontmatter-only document model: the blueprint source is YAML frontmatter plus an empty (whitespace-only) markdown body; a non-empty body fails with markdown-body-not-allowed (TeamBlueprint is a complete snapshot, not a document)
contentHash is derived, never a source field: sha256: + hex(sha256(canonicalJsonStringify(toHashableBlueprint(core)))), absent optional fields normalize to null so key presence never changes the hash
Pure-TS SHA-256 implementation (no node: crypto, per the no-node-builtin rule) pinned against NIST test vectors
Recursive memberId quarantine: a member id colliding with any other member id at any nesting depth in the parse tree is rejected, not just at the top members[] level

Closed field sets: every blueprint object validates against a fixed field allow-list; unknown fields fail loud with UNKNOWN_FIELD listing each offender (acceptance: 'unknown fields/version fail loud')

Catalog revision ordering: digit revisions compare numerically ascending with length-first tie-break before digit count, non-digit revisions lexicographic after digit ones (deterministic total order for compareRevisions)
Catalog is shallow Object.freeze at the catalog level; each blueprint entry is deep-frozen (blueprints are the immutable units; the catalog map itself is a stable read-only view)
teamContractError details are built exclusively from statically JSON-safe values; unknown-origin values pass through contracts v1 toRemoteSafeDetail (never throws, coerces to RemoteSafeJsonValue)

takeString is a plain (non-generic) helper; the single required:true call site asserts the invariant with '!' because required:true never yields undefined (it throws instead) — a generic conditional return failed to typecheck under strict

structural_notes: STEP 3 (tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json) is red by design during D1: the shared domain tsconfig (rootDir ".", include src+test) is frozen by the R11 ruling in SESSION_ROUTER_LOG.md L221 — '共享文件（domain package.json / src/index.ts / tsconfig.json / vitest.config.ts / test/domain.test.ts）D1 期间无人编辑；最终接线由 P3-T6 集成处理'. The sanctioned relative contracts imports pull contracts v1 .ts sources into the program outside rootDir -> 18x TS6059. All 18 classified: 18 TS6059, 0 semantic. No D1 worker can clear this without writing a frozen shared file; P3-T6 integration owns the fix (rootDir/include adjustment or contracts dist consumption).

Consequently the comprehensive typecheck of record for P3-T2 is STEP 2: packages/domain/blueprint/tsconfig.json (noEmit; extends root base; includes src + testdata + t2 tests + t2-helpers + contracts sources as type deps) — green. Note the extends path from the owned subdir is '../../../tsconfig.base.json' (three levels to repo root); the R11 '../../' figure is the contracts-import depth from the subdir root, a different path.
The plain-node runner prints only the first stack line of import/evaluation errors (importError.split('\n')[0]); full messages were reproduced with a node:module.register probe (debug run D3).
dependency_note: yaml@2.9.0 is the sole new third-party dependency (TaskDoc allows a standard YAML parser). Lockfile diff is minimal (zero-dep package). Two v2 pitfalls resolved: (1) CJS entry under NodeNext type stripping — Node's cjs-module-lexer surfaces only part of module.exports, so parse/YAMLError are bound through the default import (esModuleInterop true); (2) 'YAMLException' is a v1 name and does not exist in yaml v2 — v2 exports YAMLError (with linePos), YAMLParseError, YAMLWarning from dist/errors.d.ts, re-exported at the package root.
